'''Zeq Rudy''' (also published as '''Bob Jones'''; DeckTech handle '''BigZeq''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[April 2001 Lancaster tournament]] on 1 April 2001, according to Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2003">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ lancaster-pa-4-2-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ GitHub Pages].</ref> His DeckTech byline, Bob "BigZeq" Jones, was a pseudonym: Gallo-Cornell's August 2001 Lancaster report says "bob jones real name is Zeq Rudy".<ref name="tr-d2825">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-lancaster-pa-8-11-01d2825/ lancaster-pa-8-11-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-lancaster-pa-8-11-01d2825/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Under that byline he posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list and a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.<ref name="dt-15561">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15561 EBO Swarm Beat Down], DeckTech (Bob "BigZeq" Jones, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15561/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15561/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
